This file implements flash swap logic for the RP2040 architecture using the `flash_swap_ops` interface to abstract flash driver operations. It exports `flash_swap_append` to sequentially write data to an erase-aligned image and `flash_swap_rewrite` to copy ranges through a spare sector for atomic updates. The module relies on internal headers `rp2040/dev/flash.h` and `rp2040/dev/flash_swap.h` while enforcing strict alignment constraints on program pages and erase sectors. Design decisions separate geometry loops from the driver to facilitate testing against NOR models that reject unaligned calls or 0-to-1 bit transitions.
